# ebuild

> llms.txt for the ebuild repository (embeddedos-org/ebuild).
> Status: the EmbeddedOS build tool — one build system
> driving firmware builds across the org's boards and repos.

ebuild is the build tool for the EmbeddedOS ecosystem: it builds
eos, eBoot and application firmware from declarative project
files, manages pinned dependencies, and carries the model
quantize/convert step of the Track 1 tightly-coupled AI path.
The `core/` tree holds vendored mirrors of eos/eBoot and is not
part of this documentation set.
